time.snapshot: latest snapshot_time for hotel_id and stay_date

flow_conversion.time: the complete business date immediately before the S2 PMS target date; retain each platform business_date, snapshot and unit
flow_conversion.rule: vertical metrics are identified by metric_code and metric_unit; Meituan renders only FLOW_EXPOSURE_UV, FLOW_INTENTION_UV, FLOW_PAY_ORDER_CNT, FLOW_INTENTION_PER_EXPOSURE and FLOW_PAY_ORDER_PER_INTENTION, never their legacy aliases; never sum unlike metrics; distinguish no_records, missing platform, missing metric_code, and source/schema/query failure

market_competition.time: PMS target business_date for peer aggregates and lead-price metrics; monthly-loss sources retain their own period window
market_competition.rule: only peer_aggregate or loss_context; no exact room-type price gap without exact competitor products

price_and_lead.rule: show own OTA products and hotel-level lead-price metrics only; Meituan lead price is ota_business_metrics.metric_code=DAY_ROOM_LOWEST_PRICE_AVG on the PMS target business_date; the Meituan table has no platform column, so table identity supplies the channel

promotion_activity.rule: show activity and canonical room-type mapping coverage; missing mappings remain visible; a truncated product retrieval is a lower-bound count, never an assertion that no activity exists

orchestration: PMS core is required. Optional views are independent read-only queries run in parallel; S2 does not invoke S5/S6/S8/S13 or create actions.
fallback: data_gap; kf11_room_status_snapshot and daily settlement tables are not S2 fallbacks
